tasks.label: mvn: package
tasks.command: d="${fileDirname}"; while [ ! -f "$d/pom.xml" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; mvn -q -f "$d/pom.xml" package

tasks.label: mvn: test
tasks.command: d="${fileDirname}"; while [ ! -f "$d/pom.xml" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; mvn -f "$d/pom.xml" test
